jobs.title: Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Systems Analyst acts as the foundation for Meriplex’s Technical Assistance Center (TAC) and reports to a TAC Manager. This role works within the TAC’s ticketing system to resolve Level 1 end user issues. The Systems Analyst must deliver exemplary customer service while following all SOPs to complete customer requests. The person in this position is responsible for an array of end-user issues ranging from general desktop diagnostics to customer specific application support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver general workstation support.
* Provide customer specific application support.
* Troubleshoot basic network connectivity and devices/user connectivity.
* Administer incident response system reboots.
* Perform basic OS support.
* Utilize basic Azure support skills.
* Provide first level triage virtual server support to reestablish functionality.
* Driven to follow all SOP to resolve all technical issues.
* Navigate Active Directory to enact distribution groups and create, change, and disable users.
* Perform basic ITIL security to provide basic printing and connectivity support.
* Deliver scripted application support.
* TCP/IP troubleshooting abilities.
* Able to perform basic VPN connectivity issues and password resets.
* Basic end-user email support.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications.
* Basic knowledge of command line.
* Understanding of basic technical triage methodologies.
* Basic TCP/IP understanding.
* Ability to communicate both verbal and written technical information to a wide range of end-users.
* Ability to effectively set expectations regarding delivery of service.
* Strengthen customer relationships by providing exemplary customer service.
* Ability to work in a team environment; contribute as a team member and treat co-workers, subordinates, and customers with respect.
* Adherence to ticketing methodologies regarding documentation, process, and workflow.
* Support, manage, troubleshoot, and resolve service requests with the appropriate level of urgency and professionalism.
* Properly manage workflow using research, documentation, RMM tools, ticket system, and communication.

**Preferred Education, Experience, and Certifications:**

* Prior MSP support desk experience, highly encouraged.
* A+ certification.
* Network+ certification.
* Server+ certification.
* Azure support.
* Superior reading, writing, and communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of network concepts, devices, and best practices.
* Basic Microsoft 365 certification.

**Compensation:** $25.00 - $31.00 / hour

**Work Schedule/Travel:**

* Meriplex’s TAC operates 24/7 - both workday and after hours shifts available, Monday – Sunday.
* Estimated 0% travel required.

**Physical Demands:**

Sedentary Work – Exerts up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, a negligible amount of force frequently, and/or constantly having to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.

jobs.description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

**Business Systems Analyst**

**Job Overview**

The Business Systems Analyst serves as the bridge between business operations and technology, driving process improvement, system optimization, reporting, and digital transformation initiatives across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders throughout the company to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver scalable technology solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and decision-making.

The Business Systems Analyst will work extensively with ERP systems, business process automation, analytics platforms, reporting tools, and emerging AI technologies to support organizational goals. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position supports process analysis, systems optimization, reporting, automation, and technology adoption efforts across the organization while serving as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology resources.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Process Improvement**

* Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and operational procedures.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for automation.
* Facilitate process improvement initiatives across departments.
* Document current-state and future-state workflows.
* Recommend solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, user experience, and business visibility.
* Identify and implement opportunities for operational improvement through continuous improvement initiatives.

**Business Systems Administration & Optimization**

* Partner with business teams to enhance and optimize enterprise applications.
* Support ERP configuration, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), issue resolution, and change management activities.
* Ensure business systems align with organizational objectives and industry best practices.
* Support user adoption and utilization of business systems through training, communication, and support.

**Data & Analytics**

* Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using approved analytics tools.
* Translate business questions into meaningful metrics and reporting solutions.
* Analyze datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights.
* Promote data governance and reporting standards.
* Support self-service analytics adoption across the organization.
* Deliver reporting and business intelligence solutions that improve organizational visibility and decision-making.

**Automation & Digital Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using modern technology platforms.
* Support workflow automation initiatives and business application integrations.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, and recommend practical business applications.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from concept through implementation.
* Support the reduction of manual effort and improvement of operational scalability through technology-enabled solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison and partner to business leaders and subject matter experts.
* Facilitate discovery sessions and requirements-gathering workshops.
* Communicate project status, recommendations, risks, and business impacts to stakeholders.
* Provide user training, documentation, and adoption support for new solutions.
* Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships that support project delivery and organizational change.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in business analysis, business systems, process improvement, analytics, or related roles.
* 3+ years of experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical solutions.
* 3+ years of experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills in a business environment.
* 2+ years of experience utilizing written and verbal communication skills in a professional setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience with ERP platforms (IFS, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar).

* Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms.
* Exposure to AI-powered business solutions and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting change management, user adoption, and business process transformation efforts.

***The Michaels Organization is a national leader in residential real estate offering full-service capabilities in development, property management, construction, and investment. Reporting to the Director HR System and Services, the HR Systems Analyst is responsible for the system and content administration of the HRMS Platform to meet The Michaels Organizations business needs. This role involves managing and supporting the SuccessFactors environment daily. As a subject matter expert, the HR System Analyst collaborates with HR team members, HR Operations, and key business partners to optimize the system, provide recommendations for improvements, manage and analyze data, facilitate workflow, improve efficiency, troubleshoot, and enhance the platform to meet operational needs.

Responsibilities:

* Administer and support the HRMS Platform, including various modules: Employee Central, Role-Based Provisioning, Goals and Performance, Calibration, Career Development Planning, Succession, Onboarding, LMS, and Reporting.

* Ensure HRIS data quality and integrity by implementing necessary point-of-entry validations and workflow checkpoints.

* Minimum 5 years’ experience implementing, using and supporting HR systems, including at least 3 years’ experience in HRMS administration/system management in a corporate environment.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences or Human Resources field, or equivalent experience required.

* Experienced with Role-based permissions, MDF, and Business Configuration UI.

* Working understanding of HRIS reporting and payroll.
* Ability to facilitate and lead complex discussions in mixed technical and business team environments.
* Excellent interviewing skills to gather business/functional requirements from users and technical staff, applying system and business acumen to verify business needs.
* Strong critical thinking and planning skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly present complex information to business stakeholders.
* Outstanding customer service skills with the ability to analyze needs and act on stakeholder feedback.
* Self-directed with the ability to work independently and find/develop solutions for business requirements.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Guardian is seeking a Data Engineer to join the team responsible for establishing and maintaining an optimized, scalable data pipelines to provide access to high quality, consistent data in an easy and convenient manner to all authorized end users and applications of Guardian and its subsidiaries.  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will play a vital role in our data infrastructure and analytics ecosystem. You will work closely with data architects and data scientists to build and maintain data pipelines, transform raw data into actionable insights, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge data solutions. This is an excellent hands-on opportunity to experience the latest technologies and make a significant impact on our data-driven initiatives. The position will integrate new data sources from enterprise sources and external vendors using a variety of ingestion patterns including Structured Query Language (SQL) Ingestion, File, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

You will

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective data pipelines.
* Design and maintain reliable batch and real-time ingestion pipelines for databases, files, APIs, event streams, and third-party data sources, including schema evolution, error handling, and data quality controls.
* Develop and operationalize scalable data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to transform ingested data into curated, trusted, and business-ready data assets.
* Leverage Databricks to build, orchestrate, optimize, and govern production-grade data pipelines and data assets.
* Build governed, high-quality data assets that support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases.
* Design scalable dimensional and domain-oriented data models, define schemas and data contracts, and optimize data structures for performance and usability.
* Implement observability, automated data-quality checks, and proactive alerting to ensure pipeline reliability, performance, and compliance with service-level objectives.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation efforts to maintain high-quality code and data documentation.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data engineering.
* Continue to look for innovative and next generation solutions for solving data challenges.

You are

A self-starter, self-motivated team player and have excellent communication skills, enabling you to engage with all levels of stakeholders who is fueled by collaboration, able to transform conceptual designs into reliable, scalable processes that meet or exceed customer needs. An individual who works closely with IT and business leaders across the enterprise to drive and embed the Enterprise Data Strategy into transformational roadmaps ensuring key principles of Data Governance, Data Management, Data Analytics and Architecture are implemented.  
  
You have

  

* 10+ Years of IT experience, with 5+ years of experience as a Data Architect, data engineer or other data professional
* Expert knowledge of relational and NoSQL database concepts, with hands-on experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Databricks, and cloud-native data stores.
* Expert proficiency in logical, physical, dimensional, and domain-oriented data modeling, including schema design and data contracts; experience with enterprise modeling tools is preferred.
* Extensive hands-on data engineering experience with distributed data processing and lakehouse technologies, including Python and PySpark on the Databricks platform.
* Hands-on experience designing and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data-warehouse architecture using batch and incremental processing, change data capture, orchestration, and schema evolution.
* Experience with AWS data services and modern cloud data platforms, including Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, and Databricks.
* Demonstrated expertise with data sourcing, profiling, data mapping and data analysis.
* Expert SQL skills, including complex query development, performance optimization, data transformations, and scalable data-structure design.
* Ability to design secure, scalable cloud-native data solutions across object storage, lakehouse platforms, SaaS integrations, relational databases, and NoSQL data stores.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and experience effectively communicating changes across different levels in the organization.
* Communication Skills: Articulate the vision and goals, both to the team members and other stakeholders.
* Emotional Intelligence & Empathy: Motivate, inspire, and resolve conflicts with others while building a positive rapport with team members and partners.
* Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Product Manager and your leadership and keep appraised with key updates and planning. Encourage partnership between team members to create a more dynamic and effective work environment.
* Strong listeners and able to provide constructive feedback.
* SAFE experience and the ability to work on a cross functional, self-organizing development teams is a plus.

* Significant experience interfacing with both customers and management across business and IT
* Reltio proficiency and Agentic AI development with Bedrock

Location

  

* New York NY, Holmdel NJ or Bethlehem PA .
* Up to 10% travel within the NY/NJ/PA locations

**Salary Range:**

$99,150.00 - $162,885.00

The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Philadelphia
jobs.description:
The Data Engineer will join the Enterprise Data & Analytics team to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and integrations that support reporting, analytics, and business operations. Alongside hands-on engineering, this role will help strengthen the firm’s data management and governance practices through improved data quality, clear documentation, and consistent standards.

Working with colleagues across IT and business teams, you’ll translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and well-managed. You’ll support the existing data environment while contributing to efforts to modernize integrations, evaluate new technologies, and improve how data is delivered across the firm.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, SSIS, Python, and Boomi as appropriate, connecting databases, applications, APIs, and file-based sources.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and warehouse data structures to deliver consistent, well-documented datasets for reporting and analytics.
* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to deploy, schedule, and monitor Python-based data processes and automation.
* Build and maintain a reusable data quality framework, including data profiling, automated validation rules, reconciliation, monitoring, alerts, and quality metrics.
* Partner with business data owners and stewards to define quality rules and thresholds, investigate root causes, and track data issues through remediation.
* Support data governance initiatives by documenting metadata, lineage, source-to-target mappings, and critical data elements, and implementing standards and controls agreed with business owners.
* Contribute to the SSIS-to-Boomi migration, including inventorying existing processes and dependencies, documenting transformation logic, rebuilding integrations, testing and reconciling results, and supporting production cutover.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production pipelines, improving performance and reliability through logging, error handling, alerting, and recovery procedures.
* Support data platform evaluation and potential migration activities, including assessing existing workloads, adapting pipelines, validating data, and maintaining continuity for downstream users.
* Maintain technical documentation, testing procedures, and operational runbooks; communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL Server, including complex joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting production SSIS packages, ETL processes, and data integrations.
* Practical experience implementing data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and issue resolution
* Understanding of data management and governance concepts, including metadata, lineage, data ownership, stewardship, and critical data elements.
* Hands-on Boomi integration development experience is preferred; experience migrating SSIS or other legacy integration processes to Boomi is a plus.
* Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake experience is a plus, including familiarity with data ingestion, pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse workloads, and notebooks.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Familiarity with API and file-based integrations, version control, testing, and controlled deployment practices; experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and releases is preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to data accuracy, production reliability, and documentation.
* Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, learn new technologies, and explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data integration, or data management roles.
* Experience supporting integration modernization or data platform migrations is a plus.
* Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas.
* Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, or with financial systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Staff, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in.

At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them.

The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI.

* **Owns the governed context layer** as the shared foundation every human and digital worker in EAI relies on, accountable for its architecture, implementation and evolution.
* **Defines the system digital workers engineer within** through the standards, frameworks, contracts and guardrails that let them build and operate pipelines safely, consistently and at scale.
* **Raises the standard of data engineering for AI** across EAI through the architecture, governance and engineering practices others adopt, and through the senior engineers the role develops.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Context & Semantics

* **Implement and evolve the governed context layer** as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time.
* **Build the capabilities the layer depends on:** reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources.
* **Make certified meaning machine-readable** so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage.

Agent-Operated Data Engineering

* **Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks** that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative.
* **Set the operating model for agent-generated engineering work:** what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution.

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

* **Shape EAI's AI data infrastructure strategy** across feature engineering, vector and retrieval infrastructure, streaming data flows and evaluation data design, building shared components that multiple AI initiatives depend on in production.
* **Define EAI's MLOps data practices:** versioning, lineage, drift monitoring, evaluation dataset governance and model data lifecycle management, extended to the context and evaluation data that digital workers rely on.

Governance & Responsible Data

* **Define EAI's responsible data governance standards for AI pipelines,** covering privacy, consent, PII, auditability and bias controls, and encode them in the governed context layer so humans and digital workers apply them by default.
* **Shape data quality and lineage at scale** across multiple data domains, with measurable outcomes in error rates, downstream AI performance and audit readiness.

Platform & Infrastructure

* **Design EAI's data platform architecture** with infrastructure as code throughout and platform-as-product thinking, so new data and AI projects start quickly and consistently.
* **Build shared platform components** that AI initiatives, engineering teams and digital workers depend on in production, and own their reliability, performance, cost and security.

Standards & Technical Leadership

* **Define data engineering standards** for code, documentation and review, written to be followed by humans and digital workers alike, and drive their adoption across EAI.
* **Develop senior engineers** towards greater architectural independence, and partner with forward deployed engineers (FDEs), ML engineers, platform engineers and domain experts on the data requirements of production AI systems.

**Why You?**
  
**Basic Qualification**  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of data engineering experience, including experience defining data architecture for production AI or machine learning (ML) systems.
* Experience building data infrastructure for AI systems, including feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data pipelines and evaluation datasets.
* Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure used by AI systems, such as data catalogues, business glossaries, knowledge graphs or ontologies, exposed to AI agents through protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience designing and operating AI agents or large language model (LLM)-powered systems within data workflows, including evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Experience defining data quality, lineage and governance standards for AI pipelines across multiple data domains, including privacy, consent, personally identifiable information (PII) handling and auditability.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and infrastructure as code, including experience setting engineering standards.

**Preferred Qualification**  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

* Prior Staff, Principal or equivalent experience in an organisation operating a non-trivial data platform for AI.
* Experience in a regulated industry, such as life sciences, where data integrity and auditability are mandatory.

**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. **Position Overview**
---------------------

The Lead Business Systems Analyst is the functional domain lead for client Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) implementations on IBM TRIRIGA and Maximo, including Maximo Application Suite (MAS) and Maximo Real Estate and Facilities (MREF). This role is the functional authority on how the platforms should solve a client's real estate and facilities challenges: it sets the solution direction, makes and owns functional design decisions, and directs the business analysts who carry out detailed requirements and testing work. **Junior Data Engineer**

**Technology & Innovation Team**

**Location:** Irwindale, CA (100% Remote Work Opportunity)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Non-Exempt

### **Turn Data Into Possibilities. Build What's Next at Rize!**

Are you passionate about data, technology, and solving problems? Do you enjoy finding ways to turn complex information into meaningful insights? If you're looking to grow your career in data engineering while making a real impact, we want to meet you!

At **Rize Credit Union**, we're growing our Technology & Innovation team and looking for a curious, detail-oriented **Junior Data Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways to use data across our organization.

In this role, you'll help develop and maintain data pipelines, improve data quality, and create reporting solutions that empower our teams to make informed decisions. You'll collaborate with business and technology partners, explore opportunities for automation, and contribute to innovative solutions that support our mission of ending poverty through financial empowerment.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Build & Optimize Data Pipelines:** Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining ETL processes that transform data from multiple sources into reliable, accessible information.
* **Develop Data Solutions:** Write and optimize SQL queries, support data modeling, and help maintain efficient data infrastructure and data warehouses.
* **Ensure Data Quality:** Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and help maintain the integrity and reliability of information used throughout the organization.
* **Create Meaningful Insights:** Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, SSRS, or Amazon QuickSight to help teams understand and act on data.
* **Drive Innovation & Efficiency:** Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve processes, and enhance how we collect, manage, and use data.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, translate requirements into practical data solutions, and support data-driven decision-making.
* **Share Knowledge:** Document solutions, support end users, and help team members make the most of our reporting and analytics tools.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who's technically capable, naturally curious, eager to learn, and excited about using data to solve real business challenges.

**Your Background & Technical Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or database engineering.
* Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Experience developing and maintaining ETL pipelines and working with data warehouses.
* Proficiency with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, SSRS, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Familiarity with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), and data governance practices.
* Experience in financial services is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Python or R is a plus!

**What Will Help You Succeed:**

* You're a **problem-solver** who enjoys digging into data, identifying patterns, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're **curious and eager to learn**, staying interested in emerging technologies and new approaches to data engineering.
* You have **strong attention to detail** and take pride in producing accurate, reliable work.
* You're a **collaborative communicator** who can explain technical concepts and data insights to non-technical audiences.
* You're **self-motivated and adaptable**, comfortable managing competing priorities and working independently in a remote environment.
* You bring **fresh ideas and an innovative mindset**, always looking for opportunities to improve processes and create value.

### **Why Join Rize?**

At Rize Credit Union, we're more than a financial institution. We're a team of people committed to making a difference through **knowledge, access, and care**.

Our Technology & Innovation team plays an important role in helping us work smarter, improve the member experience, and create meaningful change.

As a Junior Data Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, expand your technical expertise, and help shape how we leverage data for the future.

**If you're ready to grow your career, embrace new challenges, and help us go Beyond Banking, we'd love to hear from you!**

### **Work Arrangement**

This position is based out of our corporate headquarters in Irwindale, California, with the flexibility to work **100% remotely**.

### **Compensation**

**Hourly Pay Range:** $40.00 - $53.00

This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with applicable laws. Actual compensation is determined by experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

**About iCOUNTER**

iCOUNTER is redefining how enterprises defend against cyber threats originating across their extended business ecosystems.
  
  
Our AI-native Counter Threat Operating System (CTOS) combines threat intelligence, risk determination, and operational response to help organizations identify and act on threats involving third parties, subsidiaries, portfolio companies, and interconnected business relationships.
  
  
We believe enterprises need to move beyond traditional risk assessments and static security scores toward intelligence-led, proactive defense.
  
  
We’re building a new category of cybersecurity, and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us bring it to market.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer / Data Engineer** to join our Threat Intelligence Collections team. You will design, build, and operate large-scale data collection systems that gather, enrich, and deliver high-fidelity threat intelligence from the open web, deep web, and dark web sources. This is a high-impact, technically challenging role at the intersection of cybersecurity, data engineering, and modern AI-driven automation.

You will own the full lifecycle of threat data pipelines — from raw source ingestion to clean, structured, and queryable intelligence that powers our detection, hunting, and response capabilities.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and scale high-volume data collection systems that ingest threat data from open-web, deep-web, and dark-web sources (including Tor, I2P, and other anonymity networks).
* Build and maintain robust, fault-tolerant data pipelines (batch + streaming) for ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and storage.
* Develop advanced data parsing and normalization logic for unstructured, semi-structured, and rapidly evolving threat data formats
* Design, build, and maintain agentic workflows — autonomous, LLM-powered agents that can reason, adapt, and execute multi-step collection and enrichment tasks.
* Architect and operate high-scale media pipelines for ingesting, processing, storing, and enriching large volumes of media content (images, videos, screenshots, documents, etc.) collected from threat intelligence sources.
* Design and build internal and external APIs that expose collected intelligence to downstream security teams and platforms.
* Write clean, production-grade Python code as the primary language for all data engineering and automation work.
* Collaborate closely with threat intelligence analysts, detection engineers, and security researchers to translate intel requirements into reliable, scalable data systems.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize collection performance, data quality, and latency at scale.
* Stay current with emerging threat actor TTPs, data sources, and evasion techniques to proactively improve collection coverage.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer or Data Engineer, with a strong focus on large-scale data collection and processing.
* **Deep experience collecting data at scale** from open and dark web sources (scraping, crawling, API integration, Tor-based collection, anti-detection/anti-bot techniques).
* Strong expertise in building and operating **data pipelines** (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Flink, or equivalent).
* Advanced **data parsing** skills — experience turning messy, unstructured web data into clean, structured intelligence.
* **Expert-level Python** proficiency (including async, concurrency, and performance optimization).
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing **agentic workflows** (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks) and integrating LLMs into production data systems.
* Track record of **building and maintaining production APIs** (FastAPI, Flask, or similar).
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts and threat intelligence data types (IOCs, TTPs, malware samples, phishing kits, underground forums, etc.).
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high-stakes data quality requirements.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Experience with cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of modern data stack tools (dbt, Snowflake, ClickHouse, DuckDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code.
* Prior work in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or intelligence collection organizations.
* Contributions to open-source tools or public research in the threat intel or data collection space.

* Full Health, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with 100% employee premiums covered and 90% dependent premiums covered on base plans
* 401(k), HSA, & FSA Plans
* Flexible PTO
* Meaningful equity ownership

**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the role**

As a Senior Data Engineer at Reach, you’ll work alongside our existing Data Engineering team on our data platform modernization effort. You’ll be a key contributor to our broader data practice, building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and transformations as we modernize Reach’s data stack. You’ll help establish scalable, reliable, and consistent data engineering practices across the organization, ushering in a new era of cohesive data design and management within the broader Engineering organization.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and manage data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data artifacts as a core contributor to our data squad.

* Collaborate with Data, Software, and Platform Engineers to evolve and improve existing engineering practices, tools, and infrastructure.
* Partner with data scientists, analysts, stakeholders, and cross-functional data teams across the organization to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Stay up to date on emerging data engineering tools and technologies, and help evaluate new solutions to optimize our data ecosystem.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of data pipelines using shared CI/CD tools and Infrastructure as Code solutions, such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure data quality, reliability, and availability.
* Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes.

**What you should have**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, working with dbt (Core or Cloud), Snowflake, Fivetran, Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, etc
* Strong proficiency in dbt development best practices and coding conventions, with hands-on experience designing and implementing Medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) in a production environment.
* Extensive knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores
* Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar platforms
* Experience implementing automated data quality checks, dbt testing, and data validation frameworks
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and automated deployment processes for data engineering workflows
* Demonstrated experience optimizing Snowflake performance, dbt models, SQL queries, and data warehouse costs
* Production experience working with and managing a Snowflake deployment
* Experience extracting information from SaaS systems like Salesforce using ETL tools like FiveTran
* Production experience using dbt Cloud or other source-driven transformation management tools
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Database Change Management tooling
* Experience with operational database management, including backup, recovery, tuning, data modeling, scaling
* Demonstrated experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
* Must be self-motivated, focused, and highly committed to delivering value
* Must be a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, a willingness to share knowledge, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience preparing data for analysis in Tableau or other BI tools
* Experience with Tableau CRM Analytics Data Pipelines
* Experience with Sigma Computing
* Experience with Fivetran Activations
* Experience working in the Financial Services industry and familiarity with working in a SOC2 and PCI-DSS environment.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

150,000 - 200,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

**Role: .NET Data Engineer**

**Work Type: Remote**

*Job Description*

**Role Overview**

The .NET Data Engineer will own the data backbone of an AI-driven submission management and Reserving platform for an insurance company . The .NET data engineer will be responsible for integrating, transforming, and consolidating data from various structured and unstructured sources into formats suitable for analytics and reporting. They design and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and high-performance data stores, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and reliability according to business requirements

The candidate must be working primarily in C#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure, with React on the front end, with preference for candidates who understand insurance and reserving concepts.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Data Import, ETL & SQL**

* Design repeatable processes to import data from CSV files and external APIs into SQL Server tables, then transform and cleanse it into production tables.
* Write and maintain SQL stored procedures (SPs) for data migration and transformation, using parameters and variables so the same procedure can be reused across data sources, environments, or business units (LOBs).
* Ensure stored procedures and .NET import tools are safely re-runnable (idempotent) handling duplicates, missing data, and partial failures without corrupting data.

**API & Third-Party Integrations**

* Build and maintain .NET services that integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., Salesforce) for data enrichment and synchronization.
* Handle authentication flows (OAuth client credentials, Bearer tokens) and design request/response models that map cleanly to C# classes.

**.NET Application Development**

* Design and build .NET / C# applications — Azure Functions (isolated worker model) and console utilities — that call external APIs, process data in bulk, and write results to SQL Server.
* Use dependency injection, configuration binding (appsettings.json, User Secrets, Azure App Configuration, Key Vault), and structured logging as standard patterns across all new services.
* Implement asynchronous, concurrent processing (async/await, SemaphoreSlim-based bounded concurrency) to handle bulk data volumes efficiently without overwhelming downstream APIs.
* Build resilient HTTP client code: authentication (OAuth/Bearer tokens), retry logic with backoff for transient failures, and proper error handling so a single bad record does not break an entire batch run.
* Work with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries for reading and writing application data in SQL Server.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for data-processing logic.

**React – Front End**

* Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end best practices, with the ability to build responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces.
* Develop and maintain web applications using React.js; build reusable UI components and front-end libraries for future use.
* Collaborate with backend developers to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions.

**Data Quality, DevOps & Documentation**

* Validate data accuracy after each import/migration run (row counts, key-field checks, spot-checks against source data).
* Use Git for version control (branching, pull requests) and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD (build, test, multi-environment deployment).
* Document data flows, mapping logic, and known data quality issues for the rest of the team.

**Reporting & KPIs**

* Build and maintain KPI queries/views and reporting datasets to support business and operational dashboards.
* Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable, well-documented SQL views or stored procedures.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

**Insurance Domain Knowledge**

* Familiarity with commercial insurance and underwriting concepts and the submission lifecycle (intake, triage, clearance, referral, quote).
* Understanding of common insurance data structures and documents, such as ACORD forms, loss runs, and statements of value (SOVs).
* Exposure to broker, policy, and submission data models.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Data engineer: 10 years (Required)
* .NET: 4 years (Required)
* databricks: 3 years (Required)
* ETL: 3 years (Required)
* Azure: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**Lead Data Engineer**

**About us:**

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.

At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**  
Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.

You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.

  

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask — this is the center of the role, not a component of it.
* Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.
* Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.
* Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.
* Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention policy for agent-produced data.
* Source Ingestion: Onboard new data sources to documented patterns, own schema drift and deletion detection, and partner with engineering on source schema changes.
* Vendor Direction: Scope and direct the retained architecture consultant’s ongoing work — writing specs, reviewing deliverables against approved standards, and rejecting nonconforming work.
* Self-Serve Enablement: Provide guidance and office hours for business users and AI builders to self-serve against the data platform. This role explicitly does not build reports on request.
* Documentation: Treat documentation as a core deliverable, not an afterthought. With no second data employee, documentation is Fullbay’s continuity plan for this function.
* Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
  

**Minimum Education & Work Experience:**

* 7+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a production data platform, required.
* Deep dimensional modeling experience required: able to declare a grain, defend historization choices per attribute, and articulate a restatement policy.
* Experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse) beyond SQL — warehouse strategy, cost management, RBAC, and environment design — required.
* Experience building transformations as version-controlled code with automated tests and CI required.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience with change data capture and incremental extraction from application databases required.
* Experience with entity resolution across systems with independent identifiers required.

* Comfortable being the only person who knows how something works, and documents accordingly.
* Willing to say no to a vendor, an app team, or an executive, and ability to explain why.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - US Remote
jobs.description:
#### **What is PerfectServe?**

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.  
  
PerfectServe's mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.  
  
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

* In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

* PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.  
  
If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

**About the role**
------------------

Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform.

We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly.

The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job.

**Why this role, specifically**
-------------------------------

Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled.

You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems
* Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust
* Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape
* Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks
* Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews
* Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own

**What you bring**
------------------

* Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some
* Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent
* Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework
* A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar
* Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent)
* Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves
* A testing instinct for data, not only for code

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Change-data-capture
* SQL Server sources
* Healthcare or another regulated data environment
* Exposure to a BI or semantic layer

#### **Why Join PerfectServe?**

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You'll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of **$115,000–$140,000 USD** per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

#### **Benefits:**

* Remote first work environment
* Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
* 401K - with match and immediately vested.
* 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
* Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe's cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.

We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

  

Protective is looking for a Lead Data Engineer to set the technical direction for a delivery pod building data products on Voyager, our Databricks lakehouse on Azure. You will lead the design of data products through the full medallion architecture — Bronze ingestion, Silver conformance, and Gold consumption — and be accountable for whether those products hold up for the consumers who depend on them.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management or project-management role. You will still write and review production code daily. What you own is how the pod’s data products are designed, modeled, contracted, and tested, and the standard the pod holds itself to. The Product Owner owns the backlog and the Scrum Master owns the sprint; you own the engineering.

On Voyager, the medallion layers are named Raw, Prep, and Prod. They map directly to Bronze, Silver, and Gold and are used interchangeably in this description.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Design and modeling**

* Lead the design of data products end to end: what gets ingested, how it is cleansed and conformed, how it is modeled, and what the Gold layer looks like to the people querying it.
* Own dimensional design — grain, natural and surrogate keys, Type 2 history, facts, bridges, and conformed dimensions shared across the pod’s products.
* Set the pod’s position on where logic belongs: what is cleaned in Silver, what is business logic in Gold, and what is a consumer’s own concern.
* Keep models as simple as the questions require, and push back on designs that will not hold.
* Partner with ML engineering where the pod’s Gold layer is the training or feature source for a model, so those datasets are contracted, versioned, and reproducible like any other consumer-facing product.

**Data contracts and consumer compatibility**

* Own the pod’s ODCS data contracts as real interfaces: named owners, named consumers, enforceable quality rules, freshness and update expectations, and an explicit breaking-change policy.
* Make the compatibility call on every proposed contract change, and drive consumer notification when a change is genuinely breaking.
* Represent the pod’s contracts in cross-domain conversations, where one pod’s Gold layer is another team’s dependency.

Standards, quality, and operations  

* Set and hold the pod’s engineering standards for Python, SQL, dbt, testing, model structure, naming, and repository conventions — consistent with the platform’s paved paths and Azure DevOps CI gates rather than in competition with them.
* Lead code review. Be the reviewer who catches the modeling mistake, the missing test, and the change that will break a consumer, and who explains why so the pod learns it.
* Ensure quality rules are enforced in tests and asset checks rather than asserted in documentation, and that pipeline health is observable without someone going to look — freshness, volume, latency, and cost instrumented, and alerting set against the SLAs and SLOs the pod’s contracts commit to.
* Own the pod’s operational posture for its own pipelines: failure diagnosis, data-issue triage, backfills, cost and performance tuning, on-call coverage and escalation, root-cause analysis, and runbooks someone other than the author can execute.
* Keep the pod’s delivery inside the control expectations of a regulated carrier: change management through pull request and pipeline, segregation of duties between authoring and deploying, least-privilege access, and audit evidence that falls out of CI/CD rather than being assembled for an auditor.
* Develop reusable frameworks, templates, and patterns that raise the pod’s consistency and delivery speed.

**Delivery leadership**

* Partner with the Product Owner and Scrum Master on decomposition and refinement: turn use cases and features into estimable, grounded stories with testable acceptance criteria and an identified target layer and repository.
* Hold the Definition of Ready before the pod commits and the Definition of Done before the pod calls something finished — merged and approved code, passing CI and coverage gates, and evidence that the outcome is real.
* Identify unknowns that need a spike rather than an estimate, and say so during planning rather than mid-sprint.

**Mentorship and collaboration**

* Grow the engineers on the pod through design review, pairing, and code review rather than by taking the hard work yourself.
* Bring new engineers up to productive speed on the platform’s conventions and tooling, and reduce single points of knowledge — no data product that only one person understands.
* Work with the platform team on capability gaps: when the pod needs something the platform does not yet offer, raise it as a demand signal rather than building a private workaround.
* Partner with the DataOps/MLOps Lead on the shared CI/CD, orchestration, and observability standards — adopt and strengthen the paved path rather than forking it, and be the pod’s voice on what it is still missing.
* Work with data architecture and governance on solution shape, Unity Catalog placement, and access requirements.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered.
* 6+ years building and operating production data pipelines and consumer-facing data models, from source ingestion through to published data products.
* Strong hands-on Python and SQL, with the credibility to make design calls and the willingness to still write and review code.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable Spark-based lakehouse, including Delta Lake, MERGE, incremental process

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Anika Systems is an outcome-driven technology solutions firm that guides federal agencies in solving complex business challenges and preparing for the future. Our services span AI Strategy, Data Intelligence, AI & Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Platforms and Engineering, with a specialized focus on National Security and Federal Financial programs. We are dedicated to delivering forward-thinking solutions that accelerate the critical missions of our government clients. This position is 100% remote.  
  
**Position Summary**  
We are in search of a highly collaborative and experiencedData Analyst to support the Office of Chief Data Officer (OCDO) and the Office of Performance Quality (OPQ) for a federal government contract. In this role, you will design and maintain robust data pipelines, perform in-depth analysis of large-scale datasets, and deliver actionable insights that drive mission decisions. You will work within a Databricks environment leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python, to transform raw agency data into reliable, governed, and analytics-ready assets. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with analytical acumen and is comfortable operating within complex federal data environments.  
  
**Candidates** **must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a government suitability clearance.**

* Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, or Google Cloud for Government.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including automated testing and deployment using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Working knowledge of data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI) and experience connecting them to Databricks SQL endpoints.
* Familiarity with Unity Catalog for data access control, lineage, and governance within Databricks.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Database Engineer on the Professional Archive team, you'll operate as a subject-matter expert for the data infrastructure that powers our platform – driving the architecture, scaling, and reliability decisions that keep high-velocity, compliance-critical systems performant and secure. You'll work with SQL Server environments spanning multi-terabyte data volumes, tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100,000 transactions per second.

You'll work independently through ambiguous and unfamiliar problems, set technical direction for real-time data pipelines and system performance, and act as a go-to resource for engineers across the wider organization. Your work will directly shape how Smarsh clients meet their compliance needs through scalable, dependable data and search capabilities.

You'll partner with leaders across Product Management, Engineering, and Site Reliability, weighing a range of inputs to resolve complex challenges and influence strategy beyond your immediate team. We're looking for someone who brings deep technical judgment, mentors others, and is motivated to make an impact through thoughtful, high-leverage engineering.

### **How will you contribute?**

* Serve as a subject-matter expert for database architecture and performance, guiding engineers through complex or ambiguous technical problems where established principles don't fully apply
* Set the technical approach for scalable data solutions, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability to shape direction rather than simply implement it
* Drive larger, cross-functional projects from design through delivery, proactively identifying and addressing upstream and downstream impacts before they become issues
* Informally mentor other engineers, modeling sound engineering discipline and raising the technical bar for the wider team
* Shape how the team adopts modern engineering practices, including Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps principles
* Review code and database changes with an eye for systemic risk and performance, while also leading efforts to pay down technical debt across systems

* Advanced, wide-ranging experience with database systems, with the judgment to operate independently in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations
* Deep expertise designing logical and physical data models, including schema design and data relationships, at a level others rely on for direction
* A demonstrated ability to set database performance strategy by tuning queries and indexes and establishing standards that others follow
* Strong command of data security practices (encryption, access controls, auditing), with the ability to shape how the team approaches them
* A track record of independently troubleshooting complex issues in systems that require high availability, serving as an escalation point for others

  + 7+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in a production environment, with demonstrated impact as a subject-matter expert

  + Experience designing for horizontal as well as vertical scalability, anticipating data growth before it becomes a production risk

jobs.title: Application Integration Engineer 1

A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.  
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

**Meet the Team:**

The Application Integration Engineer designs, implements, and supports Torc's enterprise-wide application ecosystem to deliver optimal performance, security, and value. This role applies a deep understanding of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and supports complex data flows between systems while prioritizing data integrity and security. The Application Integration Engineer defines and supports Enterprise IT's automation goals using industry best practices and methodologies for code management, configuration, and orchestration. Partners with external departments, teams, and users to provide cross-functional solutions that benefit the company. Serves as the technical steward and subject matter expert of the system integrations they support.

* Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and support secure data flow between enterprise information systems and their related applications. Systems include HCM and ERP, CRM, and IAM.
* Assist in the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new software and systems that integrate with enterprise applications.
* Review existing integrations and recommend optimizations that maximize data integrity, process efficiency, and user experience.

* Write and maintain clear documentation, including diagrams, architecture design reviews, runbooks, test plans, policies, and procedures.

**What you'll need to Succeed:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Development, or related field plus demonstrates competences and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 0-4+ years of experience. Work experience equivalent accepted in lieu of graduation and degree.

* Understand SDLC best practices and how it applies to applications, systems, and infrastructure.

* Demonstrate knowledge of database architectural best practices and ETL (extract, transform, load) tools.

**Perks of Being a Full-time Torc'r**

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

* 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
* 401K plan with a 6% employer match

jobs.description:
**Integration Engineer**

**Location:** Irwindale, CA (100% remote flexibility is an option)

**About the Role**
------------------

Rize Credit Union is looking for an Integration Engineer to build and operate the integrations and automated processes that connect our core, ancillary, and SaaS applications. An automated process is only as capable as the systems it can reach and only as trustworthy as the controls around it, and this role owns both.

You will design, build, deploy, monitor, and retire integrations. You will also expose internal and vendor applications as governed, authenticated, least-privilege services. Working closely with our business analysts, who identify and shape automation opportunities, you will decide what should be automated, what should not, and how to do it safely in a regulated financial institution.

This position is based out of our headquarters in Irwindale, CA, with the flexibility to work 100% remotely. You will report to the Director, Business Technology.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and maintain integrations using our iPaaS platform, REST and SOAP APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions)
* Build and maintain API wrappers and connectors, with accurate specifications and documentation
* Choose the right approach for each opportunity (deterministic integration, conventional code, or a change to a human process) and document your rationale
* Establish how integrations authenticate and what they are permitted to do, including scoped IAM permissions, credential vaulting, and rotation
* Define controls and action boundaries for every integration, and treat all external data as untrusted input
* Build automated test suites and track error, latency, and failure metrics
* Instrument integrations with logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks so every action can be reconstructed for troubleshooting, audit, and regulatory examination
* Maintain the technical inventory of integrations, automated processes, and APIs, and retire what is unused or superseded
* Work with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance to review integrations before production release, including member data handling and third-party and open-source components
* Keep all code in source control with peer review, testing, and CI/CD, and document architecture and reusable patterns so knowledge is shared

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 4–7 years of experience building and operating production software, integrations, or automation, with strong hands-on Python
* Demonstrated experience integrating systems through REST APIs, including authentication patterns (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys), error handling, retries, idempotency, and rate limiting
* Experience deploying and supporting workloads in AWS
* Experience with version control, peer code review, automated testing, and CI/CD practices
* Working knowledge of SQL, AWS services for integration workloads, and containerization
* Sound judgment about what an automated process should and should not be permitted to do
* A security-first mindset, with default assumptions of least privilege and untrusted input
* Ability to explain the capabilities and limits of automation honestly to non-technical stakeholders, including recommending against automation when that is the right answer
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated experience and a reviewable portfolio of built work will be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

* Financial services or credit union experience
* Administration and development on an iPaaS platform
* Event-driven architecture on AWS (e.g., SQS, SNS) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform)
* Experience with test automation, logging, and monitoring tooling
* Identity and secrets management (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Amazon Cognito, AWS Secrets Manager) and API gateway patterns
* Familiarity with NCUA expectations and GLBA and nonpublic personal information handling

**Pay**
-------

The pay range for this position in California is **$87,500 – $121,000 per year**. Actual pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Rize Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer of women, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.
