jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Site Integration Engineers report to the Project Engineering Manager within the Project Delivery department. A key enabler of Mainspring’s mission is the ability of its team to deliver solutions based on our linear generator technology that solve customer problems in the cross-section of resiliency and clean power supply.

The project engineering team provides the technical expertise, guidance, and support to deploy linear generators into the field efficiently—building customer confidence and enabling future scalability. This role owns site-level readiness after construction is complete, ensuring that all mechanical, electrical, control, and communication systems are fully integrated, validated, and ready to transition into commissioning and operation. Generator commissioning is performed by a separate team; this role ensures the site is ready for it. Acting as the technical integration authority on site, this role bridges engineering design intent and real-world system operation.

### **Responsibilities**

This role will be responsible for:

* Interpreting technical project details, including scopes of work, sequences of operation, control narratives, and engineering drawings (site plans, P&IDs, single-line, and three-line diagrams), and serving as the controls subject matter expert in design reviews
* Verifying relay settings, meter configurations, and controller programming delivered by third-party integrators against approved settings files and design documents
* Owning site readiness on assigned projects by validating installation quality and accuracy of balance-of-plant systems such as fuel, electrical, metering, protection relays, and communications; developing punch lists and driving issues to closure when discrepancies are found
* Validating electrical and mechanical installations against drawings and specifications by witnessing and/or reviewing results of checks such as wiring and termination verification, grounding, insulation resistance and continuity testing, phase rotation, and electrical acceptance test (NETA) reports; and equipment setting and anchoring, gas piping pressure and leak tests, purging, ventilation and exhaust, and fuel regulator setup
* Configuring equipment and verifying functional readiness of site-level control and communication systems prior to energization, including troubleshooting industrial communication networks (e.g., Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA)
* Supporting integration with customer PLC/SCADA/HMI platforms (e.g., Ignition, SEL RTAC, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA Wonderware, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Schneider EcoStruxure) for system monitoring and control
* Coordinating handoff to the generator commissioning team, confirming all site-level prerequisites are complete before units are started, and keeping project stakeholders updated on readiness status and next steps
* Planning Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and system-level validation, defining acceptance criteria for customer and utility witness testing, and confirming that as-built operation matches design intent
* Supporting Permission to Operate (PTO) by compiling documentation based on utility requirements and building an accurate submission package for the Interconnection team to issue to the utility
* Owning site QA/QC documentation and ensuring systems are fully validated and ready for turnover to operations and the customer
* Establishing repeatable processes, including ready-for-commissioning and ready-for-testing checklists, lookahead dashboards, SAT templates, equipment configuration and how-to guides, site procedures, etc
* Travelling to project sites as needed to confirm readiness and perform necessary testing

### **Job Qualifications and Experience**

* B.S. degree in Electrical, Controls, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Equivalent field experience may be substituted
* 5+ years in pre-commissioning, site commissioning, field applications, or controls engineering on power generation, battery storage, solar, microgrid, or industrial facility projects
* Experience configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting devices and platforms such as:
  + Protective relays and automation controllers: SEL (relays, RTAC), GE Multilin, Beckwith, or ABB.
  + Revenue and power quality meters: SEL-735, Schneider ION, GE kV2c, or Itron
  + PLCs: Allen-Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7, or Schneider Modicon
  + SCADA/HMI: Ignition, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA (Wonderware), or Rockwell FactoryTalk View
* Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA, DNP3) and OT networking
* Ability to interpret single-line and three-line diagrams, P&IDs, control narratives, and sequences of operation
* Understanding of balance-of-plant systems, including fuel/gas, low- and medium-voltage electrical, metering, protection, and communications, with the ability to read construction plan sets and acceptance test reports and a working knowledge of NEC and NFPA 37/54
* Experience planning and documenting Site Acceptance Testing and supporting utility witness testing for PTO
* Familiarity with field safety practices and energization standards and procedures (e.g., NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout), including Lockout/Ta

jobs.title: Recruiting Systems & Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Overview**

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Recruiting Systems & Data Integration Engineer to build and operate the connections between engin and our customers’ recruiting systems.

You will own integrations across the full recruiting lifecycle. At the top of the funnel, you will synchronize jobs for distribution and ingest applications, candidate profiles, resumes, and related data so Suzy, our AI agent, can analyze and interview candidates. Further down the funnel, you will capture events such as submissions, interviews, offers, placements, starts, and hires so customers can measure performance, attribution, and recruiting outcomes.

This role goes beyond traditional ATS integrations. ATS platforms vary widely in their APIs, data models, reporting capabilities, and integration maturity. When a standard integration through platforms such as Merge or Kombo is insufficient, you will determine the most reliable alternative. That may involve working directly with an ATS API, using webhooks or exports, processing XML feeds, or engineering agentic integration workflows when no clear API path is available.

You will own these integration problems from investigation through production operation.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build, maintain, and improve integrations between engin and customer ATS platforms.
* Synchronize jobs and their associated requirements, locations, compensation details, and status changes for distribution through engin.
* Ingest applications, candidate profiles, resumes, screening responses, and related records needed by Suzy to analyze and interview candidates.
* Reliably return relevant results and updates from engin and Suzy to customer systems.
* Capture downstream recruiting events such as submissions, interviews, offers, placements, starts, and hires.
* Translate different ATS data models and customer workflows into a consistent model spanning jobs, candidates, applications, activities, and outcomes.
* Build the data foundation for recruitment marketing attribution, funnel analysis, conversion measurement, and operational KPIs.
* Work with unified integration platforms such as Merge and Kombo while recognizing when their abstractions do not expose the required functionality or data.
* Integrate directly with ATS APIs, webhooks, reporting systems, scheduled exports, and other available interfaces.
* Design secure, maintainable agentic solutions for systems where conventional API-based integration is unavailable or incomplete.
* Build workflows to ingest, validate, transform, and produce XML data feeds.
* Operate high-volume synchronization workflows, including bulk imports, incremental updates, backfills, retries, and reconciliation.
* Handle pagination, rate limits, long-running jobs, partial failures, duplicate records, and inconsistent source data.
* Monitor integration health and investigate discrepancies between customer systems and engin.
* Create internal tooling that helps engineering and customer-facing teams diagnose integration issues.
* Partner with product, customer success, and engineering to define customer-specific integration requirements.
* Design integrations that protect sensitive candidate and customer data through secure authentication, least-privilege access, appropriate logging, and responsible data retention.
* Lead technical discovery and troubleshooting conversations with customer stakeholders during onboarding and ongoing operation, explaining complex integration issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Work agent-first using tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code for implementation, investigation, testing, and documentation.
* Document integration architecture, customer configurations, data mappings, operational procedures, and known system limitations.

**Why This Role Matters**

ATS integrations are the foundation of engin’s product experience. Jobs must flow accurately into engin for distribution, and applications and candidate data must be available to Suzy so she can analyze, screen, and interview candidates effectively. The resulting activity and outcomes must then flow back into customer systems.

Customers also need visibility into what happens throughout the recruiting lifecycle—from job distribution and candidate acquisition through submissions, interviews, placements, and hires. Accurate, timely data enables automation, improves the candidate experience, and allows customers to understand the return on their recruiting efforts.

You will build the infrastructure that connects this entire lifecycle, even when the underlying ATS makes it difficult.

**Pay range:** **$120000 to $145000 per year**
----------------------------------------------

### **Required skills**

* Professional experience building ATS, HR technology, or recruiting-system integrations.
* Familiarity with one or more ATS platforms such as Bullhorn, Avionté, JobDiva, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, iCIMS, or SmartRecruiters.
* Experience integrating third-party systems through REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, scheduled jobs, file transfers, or data exports.
* Strong Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL skills.
* Experience modeling and synchronizing interconnected records such as jobs, candidates, applications, submissions, and placements.
* Experience designing data synchronization systems where correctness, idempotency, throughput, and recovery from partial failures matter.
* Experience processing large volumes of operational data through batching, pagination, incremental synchronization, and backfills.
* Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, understand inconsistent data models, and turn ambiguous requirements into reliable solutions.
* Strong debugging skills across authentication, data mapping, API behavior, synchronization state, and data quality.
* A practical approach to engineering reliable systems without unnecessary complexity.
* Comfort owning customer integration problems from initial discovery through deployment and ongoing sup

jobs.description:
Join our team and experience how we lead with passion, positivity, and accountability to deliver the Right Talent. Right Now. We create an environment where you can think big, have fun and truly make a difference.

For more than 40 years, Oxford Global Resources has helped organizations solve complex business and technical challenges by connecting them with specialized expertise. We work across industries including technology, life sciences, engineering, and healthcare, providing services that range from individual staffing support to co-managed projects and fully managed programs.

Our work is built on understanding what each organization needs and bringing the right people and approach to the challenge. Behind that work are teams across Oxford who strengthen how we operate, support our people, and help us deliver for clients. If you’re looking for a place where your work connects to a larger purpose and has a visible impact, there’s an opportunity to do that here.

**What We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for a hands-on Data Engineering Lead to guide our data engineering team and shape the next stage of Oxford’s enterprise data platform. Reporting to the Director of Data Operations, you’ll lead a team of two to four engineers while remaining closely involved in architecture, development, troubleshooting, and delivery.

Oxford’s data environment spans Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Your mandate is to connect those ecosystems thoughtfully, reduce redundancy, and build a clear path toward a strong, consolidated Fabric platform without disrupting the business. You’ll set engineering standards, strengthen platform reliability, and partner across analytics, technology, and the business to turn changing requirements into dependable data products.

**Remote, Eastern U.S. | Exempt | Reports to the Director of Data Operations**

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers through clear priorities, project planning, code reviews, coaching, and career development.
* Own the platform strategy across Azure and Microsoft Fabric, identifying overlapping pipelines, storage, and tooling and creating a practical roadmap to consolidate or retire redundant components.

* Build and mature Oxford’s Microsoft Fabric platform, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, and OneLake, while defining what should remain in Azure and what should move into Fabric.
* Develop complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database solutions while managing, monitoring, and optimizing SQL Server database environments for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Design, optimize, test, and maintain the stored procedures that support Oxford’s core ETL processes, with disciplined version control and performance management.
* Manage transformation pipelines end to end, including orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, failure handling, troubleshooting, and recovery.
* Lead impact analysis and change management for major upstream source-system changes, coordinating with platform owners and downstream stakeholders so the warehouse adapts before the business is disrupted.
* Establish and reinforce standards for data quality, testing, observability, documentation, security, and CI/CD.
* Partner with analysts, BI developers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, scalable data products.
* Manage platform reliability, performance, and cloud cost while applying sound governance practices around access, lineage, compliance, and PII handling.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches, make clear build-versus-buy recommendations, and communicate priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and progress to technical and nontechnical leaders.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

**Required**

* Five or more years of data engineering experience, including at least two years leading engineers formally or as a technical lead.
* Strong, hands-on experience using Microsoft Fabric in a production environment, beyond evaluation or proof-of-concept work.
* Working knowledge of Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Azure SQL, and how those services integrate with or overlap Microsoft Fabric.
* **Advanced T-SQL skills, including experience writing, tuning, testing, and maintaining stored procedure-based ETL at scale.**
* Experience orchestrating and monitoring transformation pipelines, with a demonstrated ability
* to diagnose and resolve production failures.
* Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Spark or PySpark.
* A strong foundation in dimensional and lakehouse or medallion data modeling, along with modern ETL and ELT design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code, using tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions and Terraform or Bicep.
* Clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders while balancing hands-on delivery with team leadership.

**Preferred**

* Microsoft Certified Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate DP-600 or Fabric Data Engineer Associate DP-700 certification.
* Experience managing data from enterprise source platforms such as Salesforce, ATS or VMS platforms, and ERP or finance systems, ideally in staffing or business services.
* Experience leading a data-platform migration or consolidation.
* Familiarity with applying AI to the data estate, including grounding large language models and natural-language query tools in governed semantic models and evaluating the accuracy of AI-generated answers.

**What We Bring to the Table:**

**Salary Range**

The reasonably expected annual base compensation range for this position is $120,000–$150,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum targets for new hires across the United States. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills, experience, geographic location, and applicable state or local laws.

jobs.description:
**Job title:** Staff Data Engineer

**Reports to:** Director, Data Engineering

**Department:** Central Services

**Location:** Remote

 **About Priority:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

The Staff Data Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing and evolving scalable data architecture across Priority Holdings’ payments and commerce ecosystem. This role provides technical leadership across data ingestion, processing, Snowflake platform capabilities, data delivery, and data products, while helping establish engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams. You will work on complex, cross-domain problems that require strong technical judgment, influence architecture and platform direction, and enable multiple engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-effective data solutions. The role also provides an opportunity to shape emerging capabilities in AI, automation, and MCP-enabled data access as the organization expands its data platform strategy.

* Leads the technical design of large-scale data systems, pipelines, and platform capabilities across multiple domains and engineering teams.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This is a remote position.

We are looking for a candidate to provide advanced data engineering expertise to support HITU modernization initiatives and enterprise data management capabilities. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining secure, scalable, and reliable data solutions that enable reporting, analytics, decision support, and operational insight across clinical, administrative, and business functions. The Data Engineer supports the development of data integration frameworks, pipelines, and data architectures to ensure that organizational data is accessible, accurate, and aligned with HITU’s strategic objectives. All technical activities are performed within authorized Government-managed platforms and environments under Government oversight and approval.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines and integration processes that collect, transform, validate, and store data from a variety of internal and external sources.
* Support enterprise analytics and reporting initiatives by optimizing database structures, data models, and data storage solutions for performance and scalability.
* Implement data quality controls, validation procedures, and reconciliation processes to improve the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of organizational data assets.
* Facilitate the integration of clinical, operational, and administrative datasets in support of enterprise reporting and analytics requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Strategists, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Solution Developers to support business intelligence, reporting, and analytics initiatives.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for data architectures, data flows, transformation logic, integration processes, and system dependencies.
* Support data governance activities, including metadata management, data lineage documentation, auditing, and compliance monitoring.
* Ensure data solutions comply with applicable federal security, privacy, records management, and data governance requirements.
* Analyze and troubleshoot data-related issues, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions to support operational continuity and performance.
Assist with the development and implementation of data standards and best practices that promote consistency and interoperability across the HITU data environment.  

  
  

### **Requirements**

* Extensive experience with SQL, relational database technologies, data modeling, and database optimization.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT processes, data integration solutions, and automated data workflows.
* Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms, enterprise analytics environments, and modern data architecture concepts.
* Understanding of healthcare, Health IT, or large-scale enterprise data environments and associated data management challenges.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities with a focus on data quality and integrity.
* Experience developing and maintaining data documentation, technical specifications, and process workflows.
* Familiarity with data governance principles, metadata management, auditability, and data lineage practices.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams supporting enterprise data initiatives.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Ability to obtain a DHS Public Trust Clearance.

**Operating Environment:**

  

This position supports enterprise data engineering, analytics, and integration initiatives within Government-managed platforms and environments. Responsibilities include the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of approved data solutions under Government oversight. The role does not exercise operational control over Government systems and performs all activities in accordance with established security, privacy, and governance requirements.

jobs.title: SQL Developer & Analyst (Remote Opportunity)
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a **SQL Developer / Data Analyst** for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) by providing SQL development, data analysis, reporting, and data quality monitoring for ongoing electronic health record (EHR) modernization initiatives. The developer will work with large clinical and operational datasets, supporting data migration, integration, validation, and business intelligence reporting using SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile team, collaborating with software developers, data engineers, quality assurance personnel, and federal stakeholders. The developer will participate in data analysis, reporting, validation, and continuous improvement activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of healthcare data throughout modernization and migration efforts.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize advanced SQL queries, scripts, and transformation logic to support data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis across large clinical and operational datasets within SQL Server environments.
* Analyze and interpret healthcare data from multiple systems, identify trends and anomalies, and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and related business intelligence tools to support program reporting and decision-making.
* Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and program stakeholders to evaluate data flows, source-to-target mappings, transformation requirements, and conceptual and physical data models supporting federal healthcare data warehouses and integration initiatives.
* Develop and maintain data quality monitoring processes, validation routines, and reconciliation reports to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness throughout migration and EHR modernization activities.
* Investigate data discrepancies, perform exploratory data analysis and root cause investigations, document findings, and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping specifications, runbooks, and validation protocols.
* Support recurring reporting deliverables and evaluate AI-assisted tools for SQL optimization, automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, and technical documentation while validating generated outputs and maintaining data security and quality standards.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Requirements:**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.

Strong hands-on experience developing advanced SQL queries, scripts, and data extraction processes using Microsoft SQL Server, including working with large, complex datasets and optimizing query performance.

Experience analyzing healthcare or clinical datasets, including familiarity with healthcare data standards and systems such as HL7, FHIR, or VistA, and supporting data validation, transformation, and integration activities.

Strong understanding of relational database structures, data modeling, indexing, normalization, and performance tuning, with experience developing reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Microsoft Excel.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare data systems, including VX130, Oracle Health Millennium, or the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), and familiarity with InterSystems IRIS, Caché, mirrored database architectures, or EHR data migration and cutover verification activities.
* Experience working within Agile development environments using JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with knowledge of healthcare data governance, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, data quality monitoring, and technical documentation practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and optimize SQL queries, generate data validation and reconciliation scripts, identify anomalies, analyze trends, and produce technical documentation, with an understanding of AI output validation, PHI/PII protection, and responsible AI practices within federal healthcare environments.

**Security Clearance Requirements:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

**Benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision
* 401k with Employer Match
* PTO + Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training Opportunities
* Remote Opportunity

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

new_jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

**Business Systems Analyst**

**Job Overview**

The Business Systems Analyst serves as the bridge between business operations and technology, driving process improvement, system optimization, reporting, and digital transformation initiatives across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders throughout the company to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver scalable technology solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and decision-making.

The Business Systems Analyst will work extensively with ERP systems, business process automation, analytics platforms, reporting tools, and emerging AI technologies to support organizational goals. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical aptitude, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This position supports process analysis, systems optimization, reporting, automation, and technology adoption efforts across the organization while serving as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology resources.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Process Improvement**

* Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and operational procedures.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for automation.
* Facilitate process improvement initiatives across departments.
* Document current-state and future-state workflows.
* Recommend solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, user experience, and business visibility.
* Identify and implement opportunities for operational improvement through continuous improvement initiatives.

**Business Systems Administration & Optimization**

* Partner with business teams to enhance and optimize enterprise applications.
* Support ERP configuration, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT), issue resolution, and change management activities.
* Ensure business systems align with organizational objectives and industry best practices.
* Support user adoption and utilization of business systems through training, communication, and support.

**Data & Analytics**

* Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using approved analytics tools.
* Translate business questions into meaningful metrics and reporting solutions.
* Analyze datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights.
* Promote data governance and reporting standards.
* Support self-service analytics adoption across the organization.
* Deliver reporting and business intelligence solutions that improve organizational visibility and decision-making.

**Automation & Digital Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using modern technology platforms.
* Support workflow automation initiatives and business application integrations.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, and recommend practical business applications.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from concept through implementation.
* Support the reduction of manual effort and improvement of operational scalability through technology-enabled solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a liaison and partner to business leaders and subject matter experts.
* Facilitate discovery sessions and requirements-gathering workshops.
* Communicate project status, recommendations, risks, and business impacts to stakeholders.
* Provide user training, documentation, and adoption support for new solutions.
* Develop and maintain cross-functional relationships that support project delivery and organizational change.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in business analysis, business systems, process improvement, analytics, or related roles.
* 3+ years of experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into technical solutions.
* 3+ years of experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills in a business environment.
* 2+ years of experience utilizing written and verbal communication skills in a professional setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP platforms (IFS, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar).
* Experience with Power BI or comparable analytics tools.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, SSMS, SSIS, and SSRS.
* Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with workflow automation platforms.
* Exposure to AI-powered business solutions and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting change management, user adoption, and business process transformation efforts.

**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

We are seeking an experienced **IT Senior Systems Analyst – Finance** to join our IT team. In this role, you will design, support, and enhance SAP ERP and related finance applications that enable critical business processes. Working closely with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, support daily operations, and lead technology initiatives that deliver business value.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Finance and business leaders to analyze processes, gather requirements, and design effective system solutions.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices across SAP and related applications.
* Provide ongoing support for finance systems, including troubleshooting issues, managing service requests, and resolving user inquiries.
* Configure and implement system enhancements while ensuring compliance with SOX, SOD, and internal control requirements.
* Coordinate and execute testing activities, including unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Lead or support IT projects through all phases, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Manage small to medium-sized projects, including scope, timelines, risks, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, business users, and external consultants to ensure successful project outcomes.

This role is ideal for a collaborative IT professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, leading projects, and leveraging technology to improve finance operations.

  
**IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 8-10+ years of experience configuring, supporting, and/or implementing SAP ECC and S/4HANA FI/CO/CO-PA solutions.
* Advanced expertise in SAP Controlling (CO) and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA).
* Strong understanding of SAP FICO integration with Production Planning (PP), Materials Management (MM), and Sales & Distribution (SD) modules.
* Deep knowledge of controlling processes, including:
  + Cost and profit center accounting
  + Internal orders and budgeting
  + Product costing and cost component structure design
  + Bill of Materials (BOM) concepts and their impact on costing
  + Sales order costing
  + Standard costing versus moving average costing and related management reporting implications
  + Actual costing and Material Ledger
* Extensive experience with CO-PA, including:
  + Profitability analysis and value flow reporting
  + Allocations and top-down distributions
  + Account-based CO-PA configuration and support
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business process optimization skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly present complex information to business stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Guardian is seeking a Data Engineer to join the team responsible for establishing and maintaining an optimized, scalable data pipelines to provide access to high quality, consistent data in an easy and convenient manner to all authorized end users and applications of Guardian and its subsidiaries.  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will play a vital role in our data infrastructure and analytics ecosystem. You will work closely with data architects and data scientists to build and maintain data pipelines, transform raw data into actionable insights, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge data solutions. This is an excellent hands-on opportunity to experience the latest technologies and make a significant impact on our data-driven initiatives. The position will integrate new data sources from enterprise sources and external vendors using a variety of ingestion patterns including Structured Query Language (SQL) Ingestion, File, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

You will

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective data pipelines.
* Design and maintain reliable batch and real-time ingestion pipelines for databases, files, APIs, event streams, and third-party data sources, including schema evolution, error handling, and data quality controls.
* Develop and operationalize scalable data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to transform ingested data into curated, trusted, and business-ready data assets.
* Leverage Databricks to build, orchestrate, optimize, and govern production-grade data pipelines and data assets.
* Build governed, high-quality data assets that support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases.
* Design scalable dimensional and domain-oriented data models, define schemas and data contracts, and optimize data structures for performance and usability.
* Implement observability, automated data-quality checks, and proactive alerting to ensure pipeline reliability, performance, and compliance with service-level objectives.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation efforts to maintain high-quality code and data documentation.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data engineering.
* Continue to look for innovative and next generation solutions for solving data challenges.

You are

A self-starter, self-motivated team player and have excellent communication skills, enabling you to engage with all levels of stakeholders who is fueled by collaboration, able to transform conceptual designs into reliable, scalable processes that meet or exceed customer needs. An individual who works closely with IT and business leaders across the enterprise to drive and embed the Enterprise Data Strategy into transformational roadmaps ensuring key principles of Data Governance, Data Management, Data Analytics and Architecture are implemented.  
  
You have

  

* 10+ Years of IT experience, with 5+ years of experience as a Data Architect, data engineer or other data professional
* Expert knowledge of relational and NoSQL database concepts, with hands-on experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Databricks, and cloud-native data stores.
* Expert proficiency in logical, physical, dimensional, and domain-oriented data modeling, including schema design and data contracts; experience with enterprise modeling tools is preferred.
* Extensive hands-on data engineering experience with distributed data processing and lakehouse technologies, including Python and PySpark on the Databricks platform.
* Hands-on experience designing and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data-warehouse architecture using batch and incremental processing, change data capture, orchestration, and schema evolution.
* Experience with AWS data services and modern cloud data platforms, including Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, and Databricks.
* Demonstrated expertise with data sourcing, profiling, data mapping and data analysis.
* Expert SQL skills, including complex query development, performance optimization, data transformations, and scalable data-structure design.
* Ability to design secure, scalable cloud-native data solutions across object storage, lakehouse platforms, SaaS integrations, relational databases, and NoSQL data stores.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and experience effectively communicating changes across different levels in the organization.
* Communication Skills: Articulate the vision and goals, both to the team members and other stakeholders.
* Emotional Intelligence & Empathy: Motivate, inspire, and resolve conflicts with others while building a positive rapport with team members and partners.
* Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Product Manager and your leadership and keep appraised with key updates and planning. Encourage partnership between team members to create a more dynamic and effective work environment.
* Strong listeners and able to provide constructive feedback.
* SAFE experience and the ability to work on a cross functional, self-organizing development teams is a plus.

* Significant experience interfacing with both customers and management across business and IT
* Reltio proficiency and Agentic AI development with Bedrock

Location

  

* New York NY, Holmdel NJ or Bethlehem PA .
* Up to 10% travel within the NY/NJ/PA locations

**Salary Range:**

$99,150.00 - $162,885.00

The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

The Data Engineer will join the Enterprise Data & Analytics team to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and integrations that support reporting, analytics, and business operations. Alongside hands-on engineering, this role will help strengthen the firm’s data management and governance practices through improved data quality, clear documentation, and consistent standards.

Working with colleagues across IT and business teams, you’ll translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and well-managed. You’ll support the existing data environment while contributing to efforts to modernize integrations, evaluate new technologies, and improve how data is delivered across the firm.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, SSIS, Python, and Boomi as appropriate, connecting databases, applications, APIs, and file-based sources.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and warehouse data structures to deliver consistent, well-documented datasets for reporting and analytics.
* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to deploy, schedule, and monitor Python-based data processes and automation.
* Build and maintain a reusable data quality framework, including data profiling, automated validation rules, reconciliation, monitoring, alerts, and quality metrics.
* Partner with business data owners and stewards to define quality rules and thresholds, investigate root causes, and track data issues through remediation.
* Support data governance initiatives by documenting metadata, lineage, source-to-target mappings, and critical data elements, and implementing standards and controls agreed with business owners.
* Contribute to the SSIS-to-Boomi migration, including inventorying existing processes and dependencies, documenting transformation logic, rebuilding integrations, testing and reconciling results, and supporting production cutover.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production pipelines, improving performance and reliability through logging, error handling, alerting, and recovery procedures.
* Support data platform evaluation and potential migration activities, including assessing existing workloads, adapting pipelines, validating data, and maintaining continuity for downstream users.
* Maintain technical documentation, testing procedures, and operational runbooks; communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL Server, including complex joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting production SSIS packages, ETL processes, and data integrations.
* Practical experience implementing data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and issue resolution
* Understanding of data management and governance concepts, including metadata, lineage, data ownership, stewardship, and critical data elements.
* Hands-on Boomi integration development experience is preferred; experience migrating SSIS or other legacy integration processes to Boomi is a plus.
* Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake experience is a plus, including familiarity with data ingestion, pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse workloads, and notebooks.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Familiarity with API and file-based integrations, version control, testing, and controlled deployment practices; experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and releases is preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to data accuracy, production reliability, and documentation.
* Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, learn new technologies, and explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data integration, or data management roles.
* Experience supporting integration modernization or data platform migrations is a plus.
* Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas.
* Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, or with financial systems is a plus.

**Senior Data Platform Engineer**

**Become a Part of the NPT Team**

National Philanthropic Trust was founded in 1996. Since that time, have raised more than $95.8 billion in charitable contributions and currently manage $68.7 billion in charitable assets. We have made more than 1.1 million grants totaling more than $55.5 billion to charities all over the world. We rank among the largest grantmaking institutions in the United States.

Our mission is to increase philanthropy in society. To that end, our experienced staff of philanthropic professionals are fully prepared to help you establish and administer your donor-advised fund. NPT is led by a Board of Trustees composed of nationally known experts in philanthropy and business.

At National Philanthropic Trust, we foster a welcoming environment for all. People are valued and respected for who they are—with opportunities to bring their entrepreneurial spirit and talents to increase giving around the world. We have an inclusive, supportive, collaborative culture that makes National Philanthropic Trust one of the most rewarding places to work.

**What You'll Do**

The Senior Data Platform Engineer is a hands-on engineer on NPT's Data Platform team who helps turn governed data into reusable products that support self-service analytics, partner and enterprise reporting, external data delivery, and governed AI-enabled experiences. Working across Snowflake, dbt, Infrastructure-as-Code, and APIs, this person helps NPT define data once and deliver it consistently.

The role drives data products from discovery through production, partnering with Product and business teams and ensuring each product is secure, observable, documented, and supportable. The ideal candidate combines an analytics engineer's modeling discipline, a platform engineer's focus on reliability, and a product mindset.

**Data Modeling & Transformation**

* Design reusable, domain-focused data products in Snowflake and dbt, including dimensional models with defined grain, conformed dimensions, and shared entities that support reporting, self-service, external delivery, and AI.
* Define governed business rules and trusted financial metrics once, including time logic and point-in-time history, and drive ownership and certification with business domain owners.
* Build, test, document, and optimize dbt models across staging, core, and consumption layers, with business-focused tests and contracts, and maintain modeling standards and lineage.

**Data Engineering, Platform Operations & Observability**

* Build and operate secure pipelines into and out of Snowflake across APIs, files, Fivetran, data shares, and partner feeds, designed for idempotency, retry, replay, and predictable recovery.
* Develop, deploy, and support partner-facing APIs, secure data shares, and file-based data feeds with defined delivery expectations, monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Manage Snowflake infrastructure, roles, secure views, and masking policies through Infrastructure-as Code, CI/CD, and automated promotion controls.
* Drive platform reliability through service objectives, monitoring and alerting, runbooks, and incident response, while improving lineage, metadata, and cost visibility.

**Business Intelligence Development**

* Support governed Power BI semantic models and reports on Snowflake consumption products, keeping business logic close to the data.
* Partner with business users on certified data products, self-service, and adoption.
* Support migration of high-value reports and legacy SQL Server, SSIS, and DAX logic to Snowflake with parallel-run reconciliation and controlled cutover.

**Technical Collaboration & Governance**

* Work with Product and business stakeholders from discovery through adoption to turn business questions into agreed definitions, reusable data products, and measurable outcomes.

* Serve as NPT's technical counterpart to external implementation partners and absorb knowledge transfer to sustain the platform.
* Shape NPT standards for data products, metrics, and platform practices through design and code review, decision records, and runbooks, and mentor engineers and co-op students.

**Agentic AI Enablement**

* Enable AI by making the platform AI-ready: governed data products, rich metadata, semantic definitions, lineage, and least-privilege access so AI consumes trusted interfaces rather than raw data.
* Support governed AI connectors, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and natural-language experiences with explicit read/write boundaries, accuracy and access evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Apply NPT AI governance to all AI use: use only approved agentic tools, register tools and use cases, protect sensitive data, and verify and be able to explain every output before it is used or committed.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications are a plus, such as SnowPro, dbt Certified Developer, or an infrastructure-as-code certification.

new_jobs.title: Staff, Data Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in.

At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them.

The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI.

* **Owns the governed context layer** as the shared foundation every human and digital worker in EAI relies on, accountable for its architecture, implementation and evolution.
* **Defines the system digital workers engineer within** through the standards, frameworks, contracts and guardrails that let them build and operate pipelines safely, consistently and at scale.
* **Raises the standard of data engineering for AI** across EAI through the architecture, governance and engineering practices others adopt, and through the senior engineers the role develops.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Context & Semantics

* **Implement and evolve the governed context layer** as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time.
* **Build the capabilities the layer depends on:** reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources.
* **Make certified meaning machine-readable** so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage.

Agent-Operated Data Engineering

* **Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks** that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative.
* **Set the operating model for agent-generated engineering work:** what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution.

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

* **Shape EAI's AI data infrastructure strategy** across feature engineering, vector and retrieval infrastructure, streaming data flows and evaluation data design, building shared components that multiple AI initiatives depend on in production.
* **Define EAI's MLOps data practices:** versioning, lineage, drift monitoring, evaluation dataset governance and model data lifecycle management, extended to the context and evaluation data that digital workers rely on.

Governance & Responsible Data

* **Define EAI's responsible data governance standards for AI pipelines,** covering privacy, consent, PII, auditability and bias controls, and encode them in the governed context layer so humans and digital workers apply them by default.
* **Shape data quality and lineage at scale** across multiple data domains, with measurable outcomes in error rates, downstream AI performance and audit readiness.

Platform & Infrastructure

* **Design EAI's data platform architecture** with infrastructure as code throughout and platform-as-product thinking, so new data and AI projects start quickly and consistently.
* **Build shared platform components** that AI initiatives, engineering teams and digital workers depend on in production, and own their reliability, performance, cost and security.

Standards & Technical Leadership

* **Define data engineering standards** for code, documentation and review, written to be followed by humans and digital workers alike, and drive their adoption across EAI.
* **Develop senior engineers** towards greater architectural independence, and partner with forward deployed engineers (FDEs), ML engineers, platform engineers and domain experts on the data requirements of production AI systems.

**Why You?**
  
**Basic Qualification**  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of data engineering experience, including experience defining data architecture for production AI or machine learning (ML) systems.
* Experience building data infrastructure for AI systems, including feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data pipelines and evaluation datasets.
* Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure used by AI systems, such as data catalogues, business glossaries, knowledge graphs or ontologies, exposed to AI agents through protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience designing and operating AI agents or large language model (LLM)-powered systems within data workflows, including evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Experience defining data quality, lineage and governance standards for AI pipelines across multiple data domains, including privacy, consent, personally identifiable information (PII) handling and auditability.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and infrastructure as code, including experience setting engineering standards.

**Preferred Qualification**  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

* Prior Staff, Principal or equivalent experience in an organisation operating a non-trivial data platform for AI.
* Experience in a regulated industry, such as life sciences, where data integrity and auditability are mandatory.

new_jobs.description:
Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology quickly and accurately. We apply problem solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

  

**Our Team:**

  

The Economics Data team supports high-impact, time-sensitive headline data publishing across Bloomberg News and Bloomberg Terminal. The world’s most important market-moving economic indicators we provide relies on automated acquisition, extraction, validation, monitoring, and publishing processes that must operate with speed, accuracy, transparency, and resilience.

The team manages automated headline generation and economic data release workflows across a broad range of sources, including government agencies, central banks, national statistics offices, vendor feeds, news APIs, web sources, email-based sources, and social media channels. These workflows support critical Bloomberg products and wires, including economic indicators, automated news headlines, and downstream data delivery.

We are looking for a Senior Data Management Professional – Economics News Automation to manage, coordinate, and improve high-impact automated headline and economic data workflows. This role is focused on driving and coordinating automation-first data operations across acquisition, extraction, validation, monitoring, publishing, and remediation. You will help modernize and scale existing automation processes, reduce operational risk, improve data quality and timeliness, and strengthen end-to-end visibility across critical news and economic data workflows.

**Job Description**

**Job Title:** Senior Data Engineer, AI **Location:** Corporate

* Follow security standards for all data and tools introduced to the team.
* Contribute to technical direction by participating in design reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and suggesting improvements to development and system standards. Support the investigation and resolution of production data issues.
* Work with the Lead Data Engineer to balance business requirements with technical feasibility on new projects.

**AI-Augmented Delivery:**

* Use Wawa's AI coding harness and its curated skills as the default way of working: direct agents to draft pipelines, stored procedures, data models, and tests, rather than hand-writing every artifact from scratch.

* Verify agent output against Wawa's data architecture standards, conformance rules, and review gates before it advances to production.
* Surface recurring engineering patterns to the platform team so they can be codified into reusable agent skills.

* Handle multiple priorities simultaneously.

* Excellent communication skills.

Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP, a leading global law firm with offices in major commercial, legal, and governmental hubs worldwide, is seeking a Data Engineer. Reporting to the Data Warehouse Manager, the Data Engineer is responsible for supporting the Firm’s data services, with a focus on data integration, data warehousing, SQL development, ETL/ELT processes, data pipeline development and support, troubleshooting, and modernization initiatives.

  

This position will reside in our Philadelphia office with a hybrid in-office/remote working schedule.

**Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the Firm’s SQL Server/SSIS-based ETL processes and cloud data platforms, including Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
* Develop, support, and modernize data integration and warehousing solutions using SQL Server, SSIS, Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Microsoft Fabric, and Fabric Data Factory/Data Flows (FDF).
* Support data warehouse and OLTP environments, including data ingestion, transformation, dimensional modeling, data quality, performance optimization, and integration.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Developers, DBAs, and other IT teams to define and implement data.

* Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve production data, database, and integration issues, coordinating with other IT teams as needed.
Develop and maintain SSIS packages, Azure Data Factory and Fabrice Data Factory pipelines, SQL Server objects.  

  

**Education and experience**

  

* A bachelor’s degree from four-year college or university and a minimum of 5 years of experience, including 3 years of SQL development experience.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Fabric Data Factory (FDF), including pipeline development, data integration, transformation, orchestration, and integration with on-premises and cloud data sources as well as Lakehouses for FDF.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and modern cloud data warehouse architectures, including Fabric Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, OneLake and analytics services.
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-based ETL/ELT solutions using Microsoft Azure and Fabric.
* Experience with Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) using Microsoft SQL Server
* Understanding of Data Warehouse Design including Data Marts, Multidimensional database design, Fact Tables, Star and Snow-flake, Schemas.
* Hands-on experience in SQL and stored procedure tuning, database reorganization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-starter and strategic thinker with problem solving skills.

Computer skills including; MS Office (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel)

* Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE): Data Management and Analytics

### **Turn Data Into Possibilities. Build What's Next at Rize!**

Are you passionate about data, technology, and solving problems? Do you enjoy finding ways to turn complex information into meaningful insights? If you're looking to grow your career in data engineering while making a real impact, we want to meet you!

At **Rize Credit Union**, we're growing our Technology & Innovation team and looking for a curious, detail-oriented **Junior Data Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways to use data across our organization.

In this role, you'll help develop and maintain data pipelines, improve data quality, and create reporting solutions that empower our teams to make informed decisions. You'll collaborate with business and technology partners, explore opportunities for automation, and contribute to innovative solutions that support our mission of ending poverty through financial empowerment.

We're looking for someone who's technically capable, naturally curious, eager to learn, and excited about using data to solve real business challenges.

**Your Background & Technical Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or database engineering.
* Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Experience developing and maintaining ETL pipelines and working with data warehouses.

* Familiarity with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), and data governance practices.

**What Will Help You Succeed:**

* You're a **problem-solver** who enjoys digging into data, identifying patterns, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're **curious and eager to learn**, staying interested in emerging technologies and new approaches to data engineering.
* You have **strong attention to detail** and take pride in producing accurate, reliable work.
* You're a **collaborative communicator** who can explain technical concepts and data insights to non-technical audiences.
* You're **self-motivated and adaptable**, comfortable managing competing priorities and working independently in a remote environment.
* You bring **fresh ideas and an innovative mindset**, always looking for opportunities to improve processes and create value.

### **Why Join Rize?**

At Rize Credit Union, we're more than a financial institution. We're a team of people committed to making a difference through **knowledge, access, and care**.

Our Technology & Innovation team plays an important role in helping us work smarter, improve the member experience, and create meaningful change.

As a Junior Data Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, expand your technical expertise, and help shape how we leverage data for the future.

**If you're ready to grow your career, embrace new challenges, and help us go Beyond Banking, we'd love to hear from you!**

### **Work Arrangement**

This position is based out of our corporate headquarters in Irwindale, California, with the flexibility to work **100% remotely**.

**Hourly Pay Range:** $40.00 - $53.00

This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with applicable laws. Actual compensation is determined by experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

**Role: .NET Data Engineer**

**Work Type: Remote**

*Job Description*

**Role Overview**

The .NET Data Engineer will own the data backbone of an AI-driven submission management and Reserving platform for an insurance company . The .NET data engineer will be responsible for integrating, transforming, and consolidating data from various structured and unstructured sources into formats suitable for analytics and reporting. They design and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and high-performance data stores, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and reliability according to business requirements

The candidate must be working primarily in C#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure, with React on the front end, with preference for candidates who understand insurance and reserving concepts.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Data Import, ETL & SQL**

* Design repeatable processes to import data from CSV files and external APIs into SQL Server tables, then transform and cleanse it into production tables.
* Write and maintain SQL stored procedures (SPs) for data migration and transformation, using parameters and variables so the same procedure can be reused across data sources, environments, or business units (LOBs).
* Ensure stored procedures and .NET import tools are safely re-runnable (idempotent) handling duplicates, missing data, and partial failures without corrupting data.

**API & Third-Party Integrations**

* Build and maintain .NET services that integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., Salesforce) for data enrichment and synchronization.
* Handle authentication flows (OAuth client credentials, Bearer tokens) and design request/response models that map cleanly to C# classes.

**.NET Application Development**

* Design and build .NET / C# applications — Azure Functions (isolated worker model) and console utilities — that call external APIs, process data in bulk, and write results to SQL Server.
* Use dependency injection, configuration binding (appsettings.json, User Secrets, Azure App Configuration, Key Vault), and structured logging as standard patterns across all new services.
* Implement asynchronous, concurrent processing (async/await, SemaphoreSlim-based bounded concurrency) to handle bulk data volumes efficiently without overwhelming downstream APIs.
* Build resilient HTTP client code: authentication (OAuth/Bearer tokens), retry logic with backoff for transient failures, and proper error handling so a single bad record does not break an entire batch run.
* Work with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries for reading and writing application data in SQL Server.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for data-processing logic.

**React – Front End**

* Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end best practices, with the ability to build responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces.
* Develop and maintain web applications using React.js; build reusable UI components and front-end libraries for future use.
* Collaborate with backend developers to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions.

**Data Quality, DevOps & Documentation**

* Validate data accuracy after each import/migration run (row counts, key-field checks, spot-checks against source data).
* Use Git for version control (branching, pull requests) and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD (build, test, multi-environment deployment).
* Document data flows, mapping logic, and known data quality issues for the rest of the team.

**Reporting & KPIs**

* Build and maintain KPI queries/views and reporting datasets to support business and operational dashboards.
* Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable, well-documented SQL views or stored procedures.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

**Insurance Domain Knowledge**

* Familiarity with commercial insurance and underwriting concepts and the submission lifecycle (intake, triage, clearance, referral, quote).
* Understanding of common insurance data structures and documents, such as ACORD forms, loss runs, and statements of value (SOVs).
* Exposure to broker, policy, and submission data models.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Experience:

**Lead Data Engineer**

**About us:**

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.

At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**  
Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.

You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.

  

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask — this is the center of the role, not a component of it.
* Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.
* Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.
* Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.
* Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention policy for agent-produced data.
* Source Ingestion: Onboard new data sources to documented patterns, own schema drift and deletion detection, and partner with engineering on source schema changes.
* Vendor Direction: Scope and direct the retained architecture consultant’s ongoing work — writing specs, reviewing deliverables against approved standards, and rejecting nonconforming work.
* Self-Serve Enablement: Provide guidance and office hours for business users and AI builders to self-serve against the data platform. This role explicitly does not build reports on request.
* Documentation: Treat documentation as a core deliverable, not an afterthought. With no second data employee, documentation is Fullbay’s continuity plan for this function.
* Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
  

**Minimum Education & Work Experience:**

* 7+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a production data platform, required.
* Deep dimensional modeling experience required: able to declare a grain, defend historization choices per attribute, and articulate a restatement policy.
* Experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse) beyond SQL — warehouse strategy, cost management, RBAC, and environment design — required.
* Experience building transformations as version-controlled code with automated tests and CI required.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Experience with entity resolution across systems with independent identifiers required.
